eval.title: Am I Making a Huge Mistake With Tesla?

call.headline_quote: i really want to see tesla succeed but i'm not investing in it

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: we see the free cash flow for the trailing 12 months at 7 billion

what_is_priced_in.quote: this is betting that tesla will increase its current free cash flow 10 times over likely the next 10 years

reasons.claim: At 100x price-to-free-cash-flow, Tesla requires 5-6x more free cash flow to justify the valuation with certainty, which is not investing in what is already there.
reasons.quote: price to free cash flow now is 100 yes tesla is growing extremely fast and it will likely continue to grow but from 10 billion or 7 billion to get to somewhere where a company gives certainty

data_check.gap_note: he says 100, as-of 5.015e+09 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The bull case relies on future production of Cybertruck, Tesla Semi and other unbuilt products, which is a bet rather than a certainty.
reasons.quote: they say they will do it increase production cyber truck tesla semi roads their future products so all these factories increasing production selling already booked whatever they produce

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Bull cases assume robotaxis will make up 60% of expected value by 2026, an assumption he treats as highly uncertain speculation not yet materialized.
reasons.quote: then they base those assumption on robot taxes that will make 60 of expected value in 2026 so that is the bet plus the growth plus everything

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: robotaxi share of expected value

reasons.claim: Cathie Wood's own portfolio only allocates a small share to Tesla despite calling it a sure bet, which he finds inconsistent and undermines the bull thesis.
reasons.quote: cathy wood portfolio i don't understand this if tesla is such a sure play why only 7.2 of the investment is in tesla

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: Cathie Wood Tesla portfolio weight

reasons.claim: Many similarly speculative, story-driven stocks have collapsed 75-95% when their narratives failed to materialize, illustrating the risk of Tesla's bet not paying off.
reasons.quote: teledoc down 81 so a lot of these businesses are severely severely down coinbase 80 down 75 draftkings robin hood 75

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: Teladoc decline, Coinbase decline, DraftKings decline, Robinhood decline

external_facts_used: Ark Invest bear case price target of $2,900 for Tesla by 2026
Cathie Wood's Ark portfolio allocation to Tesla (7.2%) and Zoom (6.2%)
Performance declines of other 'story' stocks (Teladoc, Coinbase, DraftKings, Robinhood) from their guru buy prices
